properties.name: Perevi village (whole village, hand-made)
properties.method: Convex hull of OSM relation 15344012 v6 (landuse=residential, place=village, 4 patches) and way 1167376334 v1 (the part mapped inside the South Ossetia line), pushed out by 100 m in the metric_crs of config/clip.json (shapely buffer, quad_segs 8), coordinates rounded to 7 decimals.
properties.why: OSM has no administrative boundary for Perevi; the law names the village, and the landuse patches have gaps of up to 418 m and could be split or trimmed by any later edit.
